name: Shuurou!! Wanwan Human
original_name: 就労！！わんわんヒューマン
source:
You are an employee of the Miracle White Company "Angel Enterprises".

As a correctional officer, your mission is to educate the stupid and irredeemable!

Complete your duties with your trusty co-workers!

[From [url=https://samezaki.itch.io/humandog]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是奇迹白公司“天使企业”的员工。

作为一名惩教官，你的使命是教育那些愚蠢且不可救药的人！

与你值得信赖的同事一起完成你的职责！

[来自[url=https://samezaki.itch.io/humandog]Itch.io[/url]]
